author: The Infographics Show
description:
NVIDIA is about to do to CPUs what it already did to GPUs. Take control of the most valuable part of the computer and force the entire industry to build around its technology. With Microsoft reshaping Windows for AI and traditional processors losing ground, the personal computer may be entering its biggest transformation in decades.

This video examines NVIDIA’s new AI-focused chip architecture, its partnership with MediaTek, Microsoft’s Copilot+ hardware requirements, and the accelerating shift away from Intel’s x86 platform toward Arm-based systems. We also explore how CUDA helped NVIDIA dominate data centers and why companies such as Dell, HP, Lenovo, and Asus could increasingly become assemblers rather than true technology owners.
The new generation of laptops promises powerful local AI, continuous assistants, smarter search, image generation, and software that can act across your files and applications, but that convenience comes with higher hardware demands, increased energy use
title: NVIDIA is About to do to CPUs What it Did to GPUs
